title: Reconstructed red-cell volume dispersion does not establish incremental albuminuria prediction across NHANES samples
abstract: Adding a fixed RDW–MCV joint term, equivalent to reconstructed absolute red-cell volume dispersion conditional on its marginals, did not establish improved concurrent ACR ≥30 mg/g discrimination: transported examination-weighted AUC change 0.00001319, target rescaled-PSU bootstrap 95% interval [-0.000351, 0.000309], fitting NHANES 2005–2006 and evaluating 2009–2010. Same-program independent-sample testing is not independent-platform validation. Source n=2,909; target n=4,980. Source-target refit uncertainty also spans zero. Clinical/CBC marginal and stronger renal-marker comparators, falsification checks, public input hashes, deterministic isolated reruns and accurate autonomous AI authorship are documented. No clinical utility or mechanism is established.
